# NT Hair Salon

> Walk-in hair salon based in Georgetown, Texas. Cuts, color, highlights, updos, perms and waxing for men, women and children. Tell Lisa what you want, and it comes out the way you pictured it.

- Phone: (512) 863-7929
- Based in: Georgetown, TX
- Nearby areas: Georgetown, Round Rock, Leander, Liberty Hill, Jarrell, Hutto
- Google rating: 4.5 from 138 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/hair-salons/texas/nt-hair-salon/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/hair-salons/texas/nt-hair-salon/book.html

## Services
- Haircuts: Cuts for men, women and children, from a blunt cut on long fine hair to a short stacked style. Bring a photo or just describe it; reviewers say Lisa listens and gets it right.
- Color: All-over color, root touch-ups and soft silver and gray blending, finished and styled before you leave the chair.
- Highlights & lowlights: Bright blonde highlights, richer lowlights, or soft honey and caramel blended through long layers.
- Updos & curls: Half-up curls, braided updos and pinned styles for weddings, proms and big nights out.
- Perms: Perms for body, curl and wave, on short or long hair, for men and women.
- Waxing: Waxing for men and women, right on the front window: walk in and ask.

## About
NT Hair Salon is a small walk-in salon in Building 2, Suite 202, at 950 W University Ave in Georgetown. Look for the pink NT HAIR SALON letters over the door and the window that reads Perm, Waxing, Color, Haircut, Walk-ins Welcome. Inside it's sunny yellow walls, cherry-wood stations and black chairs. The menu is simple: cuts, color, highlights and lowlights, updos, perms and waxing, for men, women and children. Most people come back for Lisa, the owner. One client left two fancy salons where she paid big bucks and now says Lisa is the only one who will ever cut her hair. Others have been in her chair since 2020 and 2021, and one has trusted her with his haircut for four years.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: Yes, walk-ins are welcome Monday to Saturday. On busy afternoons the wait can be longer, so call (512) 863-7929 to check before you head over.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Friday 9 AM to 7 PM, Saturday 9 AM to 6 PM. Closed Sunday. Holiday hours can differ, so call ahead around holidays.
- Q: Where are you in Georgetown?
  A: 950 W University Ave, Building 2, Suite 202, Georgetown, TX 78626, in the shopping center on University Ave (Hwy 29). Look for the pink NT HAIR SALON sign.
- Q: Do you cut men's and kids' hair?
  A: Yes. Haircuts, color, highlights, perms and waxing are for men, women and children.
- Q: Do you do updos for weddings or prom?
  A: Yes. Half-up curls, braided updos and pinned styles are some of our favorite work. Call (512) 863-7929 to set a time so we're ready for you.
- Q: Do you do perms?
  A: Yes, perms are one of our regular services, along with color and highlights. Call to talk through the curl you want.
- Q: Do I need a reference photo?
  A: It helps, but it's not required. Tell us what you want and we'll talk it through before we start.
